q1.explanationZh: 第一段说这种鸟受到禽疟疾的威胁，而这种病是蚊子传播的，所以是蚊子带来的疾病。

evidence.quote: It is spread by mosquitoes and can be deadly to many bird species in Hawaii.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说实验室蚊子带一种细菌，和野蚊子交配后虫卵长不大，这样蚊子数量就会减少。

evidence.quote: When they mate with wild mosquitoes, their eggs do not grow.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段 However 后面说了问题：很多实验室蚊子在野外活不好。

evidence.quote: Many lab mosquitoes do not survive well in the wild.

q4.explanationZh: Logan 把实验室蚊子放到野蚊子生长的水里的微生物中，让它们接触这些微生物，所以活得更好。

evidence.quote: To solve this, he exposed the lab mosquitoes to microbes.

q5.explanationZh: 全文讲一个学生用自己的研究帮助了家乡的鸟类，作者想表现的是学生的想法怎样帮到社区。

evidence.quote: But this project showed me that youth have the power to make a difference in their community.
